description: Source code for Bluetooth direction finding central sample application using Zephyr RTOS, implementing CTE request and IQ sample reporting.

methods.name: start_scan
methods.description: Starts Bluetooth active scanning with specific parameters.

methods.name: cte_type2str
methods.description: Converts CTE type enum to string.

methods.name: sample_type2str
methods.description: Converts IQ sample type enum to string.

methods.name: packet_status2str
methods.description: Converts packet status code to string.

methods.name: eir_found
methods.description: Handles advertisement data, checks features, and initiates connection.

methods.name: device_found
methods.description: Handles device discovery events and parses advertisement data.

methods.name: enable_cte_reqest
methods.description: Enables CTE reception and requests CTE from peer device.

methods.name: connected
methods.description: Callback for successful connection; initiates CTE request.

methods.name: cte_recv_cb
methods.description: Handles received IQ samples reports from connected device.
